dependencies.required_evidence: Exact 15,675-byte q1 observer plan with SHA-256 3b38295d2ea4f0b297cab0c94934142f82f84f26cb460312889d79d64519e606.

required_evidence_surface.rolling_coordinates: start, every 64 modeled events, and terminal
required_evidence_surface.cross_arm_identity: P/q1 and K/P probability, coder, payload-prefix, six-partition state, payload, archive, modeled inverse, and raw inverse identity

source_findings.successful_path_output: The five bound overlay inputs contain no file-open, file-write, stream-output, digest, receipt, or manifest path for a successful midpoint closure. Their only fprintf calls are fatal abort diagnostics.
source_findings.arm_selection: KH_MIDPOINT_ARM selects P, K, F, or S, but no environment variable selects an evidence output root or trace sink.
source_findings.update_witness_lifetime: Detached-update sink values and detached buffers are cleared by MidpointClearScratch after each closure; no update counter, target digest, gradient digest, pre-restore state digest, post-replay state digest, detached witness, or scratch-clear digest is retained externally.
source_findings.q1_kh_trace_scope: The retained KH_TRACE surface records arithmetic probability/residual evidence, not the six required midpoint evidence-contract state partitions or its update manifest.
source_findings.q1_full_identity_observer_scope: The reusable full-identity observer hashes every post-head integer probability, coder checkpoints, and the 26 large FXCM semantic allocations changed by q1. Its completeness argument is allocation-mutation-specific; it does not register all Byte-LSTM dynamic, parameter, optimizer, ordinary-tape, or midpoint buffers.
source_findings.q1_observer_direct_reuse_limit: The q1 observer hooks only the encoder, its coder rows omit payload-prefix SHA-256, and each persistent-state checkpoint rereads then pages out every registered large FXCM range. Calling that snapshot every 64 events would read at least 6.8 TB on the 250KB gate alone, so direct checkpoint reuse is rejected.
source_findings.evidence_serialization_ambiguity: The v4 evidence contract names partition and update hashes but does not freeze a canonical preimage: field tags, traversal order, integer byte order, floating-point bit encoding, tensor geometry records, checkpoint timing relative to closure/clear/prediction, or payload-prefix digest semantics are unspecified. A future emitter could therefore satisfy the field names while remaining independently incomparable.
source_findings.receipt_schema_gap: The available cmix-shadow-midpoint-oracle receipt schema is bound to candidate v2 and does not contain the six-partition rolling surface or twelve-field update rows. No schema can currently validate the v4 evidence contract.
source_findings.materializer_scope: The frozen materializer permits exactly the five modified and four added midpoint paths. It creates no observer header or runtime harness and explicitly leaves build and archive authority false.

decision.reason: The midpoint math is reviewable, but the exact materialized source cannot emit the evidence required to interpret P/K/F/S runs under its own frozen contract.
decision.authorized_single_axis_successor: Reserve cmix_obias_shadow_midpoint_oracle64_q0_v5 as an observability-only derived source successor after q1 qualification. Preserve P/K/F/S arithmetic, populations, controls, thresholds, join/reset behavior, and resource ceilings exactly; add only a canonical binary observability ABI, fail-closed partition hashing, update-manifest emission, and receipt plumbing.
decision.reuse_rule: Reuse only the calibrated q1 observer's SHA-256, exclusive-output, post-head probability, and coder primitives. Do not invoke its full-range snapshot or pageout path every 64 events. Add matched encoder/decoder hooks, payload-prefix hashing, complete LSTM/midpoint visitors, and an incrementally hashed canonical mutation transcript for large external state with bounded start/terminal snapshots.
decision.observability_abi_rule: Before source derivation, freeze versioned domain tags, source-order partition rows, tensor names and dimensions, uint64 little-endian lengths and counters, IEEE-754 object-representation bytes for finite float state, exact checkpoint hook order, clone-finalized rolling digests, and payload-prefix byte-count plus SHA-256 semantics.
decision.negative_control: A bound one-byte mutation in each newly registered partition must change that partition digest and the aggregate while preserving the other registered partition digests.
decision.activation_order: q1-v3 qualification, v4 source materialization, v5 ABI and receipt-schema freeze, observability-only v5 source derivation, static partition completeness audit, clean-build identity, P/K synthetic fixture, then the smallest native finite-coder gate.

activation_requirements: Do not edit the frozen v4 overlay or a materialized v4 tree in place.
Every v5 source path and observer range must be content-addressed before compilation.
A versioned observability ABI and independently implemented parser must exist before observer source is derived.
A candidate-v5 receipt schema must require every ABI checkpoint, partition, update row, encoder/decoder synchronization witness, and fail-closed output status.
The observability successor must prove probability and payload neutrality against uninstrumented v4 before any F/S compression result is interpreted.
No build, fixture, coder, or corpus run is authorized while qm8 owns the full-1G lease or before q1-v3 qualification exists.
claim_boundary: This is a source observability audit, not a compilation, synchronization, compression, inversion, memory, runtime, package, or Hutter proof.
It does not reject the midpoint algorithm; it blocks scientific interpretation of the currently frozen source until its proof outputs exist.
The q1 observer remains valid for its allocation-specific identity claim and receives no broader state-completeness authority by reuse.
All midpoint and observability artifacts receive zero Gamma compression and objective score credit.
